title: Need-to-Know (NTK): an output-side protocol for what agents may say to other agents
description:
The Need-to-Know (NTK) protocol specifies what an agent may say to other agents. Each fact the agent knows carries one label (public, role:<r> or private); each inbound request carries requester, role and purpose; each outbound reply passes three checks before it is sent: (1) who is asking and why, (2) use it, don't say it, (3) a hint check against inference, alone or across the conversation. Every reply is written to a disclosure ledger, and owner consent grants are scoped to one requester and one purpose and expire.

NTK is the output-side complement to the Human Context Protocol (HCP), which governs access. This release contains the specification, reference implementations in Python and TypeScript (zero runtime dependencies), command-line tools, a Model Context Protocol server, a shared cross-implementation conformance suite and a technical report draft.
